name: Infosys Ltd.
business_summary: India's second-largest IT services company: digital, cloud, data/AI, application and BPM services (including Finacle banking software) to ~1,900 clients, North America ~57%, Europe ~28%. TTM sales ~Rs1.9 lakh cr, EBITDA margin ~24%, debt-free, ROE 32%, 4.2% dividend yield. Cut FY27 CC revenue growth guidance to 1-2% on 2026-10-23 despite $5.2bn of Q2 large deals; stock at 14.9x P/E, touched six-year lows on 2026-09-29, +14.7% in the last month.

exposures.mechanism: ~97% of revenue foreign currency; INR ~ 40% of costs (model knowledge). Infosys has disclosed ~30bp margin per 1% INR; +3% => ~+90bp on 24% = +3.8% EBITDA, persistence 0.4 (hedging, wage resets), EV/MCap 0.95 => +1.5. Pack -1.48 (t -1.0) negative, insignificant; flagged.

evidence.note: Screener: Sep-26 qtr sales 49,244 cr, OPM 24%, PAT 7,838 cr, P/E 14.9, 12m -20.8%

exposures.mechanism: North America ~57% of revenue; +1pp US growth => revenue +0.85%, incremental margin 30% vs 24% => EBITDA +1.1%, with re-rating persistence 1.0 => ~+2.5. FY27 guide cut to 1-2% CC reflects soft US discretionary demand.
